user_story:
As a new user, I want to register for a free online account so that I can access ParaBank's services. 
Acceptance Criteria:
- The registration form must include fields for first name, last name, address, city, state, zip code, phone number, social security number, username, password, and repeated password.
- The form must contain a 'Register' button that submits the data.
- If the form is submitted without filling in the required fields, the user should remain on the registration page (URL: https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/register.htm) and see the registration form still visible.
